build_backend: Wheel built locally without network using setuptools 81.0.0 and wheel 0.46.3; neither is a runtime dependency.
limitations: rpds-py includes prebuilt native code. Packaged MIT notice and binary identity recorded; this is not a source-level audit of its Rust dependency closure.
Retain included notices on redistribution. OCR code, weights and hosting are excluded.
No legal clearance is inferred from a process or adapter boundary.

wheel.schema_resources: Four packaged schemas are byte-identical to repository authorities.
